notes: All scenes are static editable design fixtures for proposed AB:66 portable workflow/version/invocation contracts. They are not runtime proof, installation instructions, executable YAML, shipped capability, independent review, accessibility evidence or cross-client parity.

One JSON file only. Parent owns native sidebar/header/project tabs/caption, reusable thread/composer and integration. This slice assigns neither Figma ids nor canvas placements. All body regions stay in the contract body area, use native Inter/token roles and 32px desktop action controls.

Setup path W00 → W01 → W02 → W12 saves a local existing-repository profile and Review change definition only. W12 → W03 is explicitly a later-record history-read after external commit/push/CI-host observation. It does not perform Git actions. W03 also illustrates two additional subsequently configured catalog entries; setup did not silently initialize them.

W01 is the configuration authoring state and W02 is its reviewed proposed file diff. The selected preset includes guidance, validation, prompt, input contract, target and provider/adapter settings. Free text, alternate presets and native-editor/Git actions are intentionally not wired, not deferred implementation placeholders.

W03 configured return never offers initialization. Its state is configuration-only and preserves caller execution context. Its Return to Work uses allowedOrigins C00/C01/C02/C03/C04/C05/C06/C07/C08/C10/C11/C12/C13/C14/C15 with default C02 only when no origin exists. C05/C06 preserve pre-plan Intake/source state; C07/C08 preserve post-add state. C09 is intentionally excluded. Parent must store the origin through W04 and target-switch review, and must not replace any captured pre-plan or postrun origin with C02. No source or plan state changes merely by navigating to configuration/version detail.

W04 is immutable Review change v1. Definition edits create a separately reviewed draft/version and do not retarget an existing invocation, provider runtime or active binding. No imported executable DAG or second scheduler is introduced. Factory execution reuses existing launch/orchestration seams; CI execution requires a proposed portable adapter and receipt/evidence contract.

W05 and W06 are alternative manual launch reviews of exactly the same pinned version, SourceRef github/acme/factory/#237/rev3, PlanItemRef env-ws/project-factory/plan-237 and candidate commit. Their explicit provider/target cannot silently fall back. Both execute workflow review and report evidence; CI is not merely later checks/build validation. Run is the only dispatch boundary.

W05/W06 Cancel is read-only back with allowedOrigins C02/C03/C04/W04. Switching target preserves the original origin through both reviews. If opened without a captured origin, the default is C02. Parent must implement this origin retention rather than ordinary browser-back to the other target review.

Factory branch W05 → W07 is illustrative accepted dispatch inv-f5-factory-01. It adds optional retained WorkRef {version:1,environmentId:env-ws,kind:issue,id:8b42f1d3} and native ThreadId8b42f1d3 to plan-237. It never replaces that plan identity or claims the pre-admission issue was already retained Work. Source Open/rev3 and planning Ready remain unchanged.

W07 is accepted-only. Its explicit View later Work history-read maps C02→C10, C03→C11, C04→C12, default C10. C10/C11/C12 are later provider-working records, so this link observes progress rather than claims accepted dispatch itself started the provider. W07 → W08 is also a later-record history-read of provider start, not a second dispatch. Fresh-launch W08 returns C10. Parent derives F5-P-THREAD-C10/C11/C12 from W08 with exact corresponding collection returns. No C16 dependency remains. Native composer/send, provider approvals/questions and stop acknowledgement remain parent-owned.

CI branch W06 → W09 records inv-f5-ci-01 and externally owned acme/factory/actions/runs/19541 queued. No retained issue WorkRef or native T3 thread is created in this CI-only branch. W09 → W10 is later external completion observation, not a local action that runs CI. W09 returns C14 queued; W10 returns C15 completed to prevent state rewind.

W11 is a read-only comparative later-history study with both alternative manual records. It is reached through explicit history-read controls, not a claim that one click launched both targets. Its Factory record points to provider-working W08; its CI record points to completed W10. Neither has acceptance, merge/release or source-close authority.

W03/W04 View later triggers controls route to F5-T00 through explicit history-read edges WE08/WE10. The trigger author classifies T00 as a later post-automatic snapshot with Work C13. These links observe that later configuration; opening a list does not admit issue238, create inv-f5-auto-01, dispatch or enable anything. Manual launches do not enable automatic bindings. A saved local or pushed platform config is not host-observed activation. Trigger enablement/history and post-enable state belong to the Triggers slice. An activated binding must not return to a stale off state as if disabled; parent should retain the trigger slice return state rather than reuse this off snapshot.

Full canonical fixture hashes are used. Definition commit fcefc5e69848dc6c5b3aa32ea45ae4e8f29d3031; candidate commit 1dfb90f9bc2e41fdc47d1f40c081d95f66c30054; Review change v1 SHA-256 e464ecf8079ddd35b1fa08327785bdd2324aea4511e47aba25b1696d265c019d. Implement issue and Diagnose CI failure v1 digests are copied from base.json. No invented universal TaskId, Git ref, private token or real runtime evidence is introduced.

Proposed file paths, provider Codex, GitHub Actions adapter selection, config syntax, readiness observations and finding/report text are illustrative project settings. The base fixture hashes are design identity anchors, not computed digests of these abbreviated configuration views. Source facts come from brief.md, experience-contract.md, base.json, ground/t3-ui-baseline.md and ground/inspiration-patterns.md. The latter two explicitly separate live shell, candidate Work and proposed AB:66 behavior.

No renderer, build, lint, tests, self-render, app source changes, provider process, external CI dispatch, Figma/browser authoring, Git mutation or integration activation was performed. Parent owns JSON/schema/geometry/link/render and actual-click verification after integration.
